paragraphs: Bessie the cow is hiding somewhere along the number line. Each of Farmer John's N other cows (1 ≤ N ≤ 1000) have a piece of information to share: the i-th cow either says that Bessie is hiding at some location less than or equal to pᵢ, or that Bessie is hiding at some location greater than or equal to pᵢ (0 ≤ pᵢ ≤ 10⁹).

Unfortunately, it is possible that no hiding location is consistent with the answers of all of the cows, meaning that not all of the cows are telling the truth. Count the minimum number of cows that must be lying.
inputFormat: The next N lines each contain either L or G, followed by an integer pᵢ. L means that the i-th cow says Bessie's hiding location is ≤ pᵢ, and G means that Bessie's hiding location is ≥ pᵢ.
outputFormat: Print the minimum number of cows that must be lying.

additionalSamples.explanation: No position x satisfies both x ≥ 3 and x ≤ 2, so at least 1 cow must be lying.

sampleExplanation.title: Sample 1 Analysis
sampleExplanation.detail: If Bessie hides at x = 4 (or 3 or 5), both x ≥ 3 and x ≤ 5 are true, so 0 cows need to be lying.

hints.title: Can We Test Every Position up to 10⁹?
hints.body: Positions go up to 10⁹, so we cannot loop over every integer on the number line. Which positions actually change the set of lying cows?

hints.title: Only the N Mentioned Positions pᵢ Matter!
hints.body: Suppose Bessie hides at some x. Sliding x to the nearest pᵢ never causes a truthful cow to start lying! So it suffices to test x = pᵢ for each of the N cows.

hints.title: O(N²) Check
hints.body: For each candidate x = p[i], count how many cows lie: a cow ('L', p[j]) lies if x > p[j], and a cow ('G', p[j]) lies if x < p[j]. Take the minimum across all N candidates! Since N ≤ 1000, N² ≤ 10⁶ operations runs fast.

editorial.summary: Only the N coordinates pᵢ need to be tested as candidate hiding spots for Bessie. For each candidate x = pᵢ, count how many ('L', pⱼ) have pⱼ < x and how many ('G', pⱼ) have pⱼ > x in O(N) time, taking the overall minimum.
editorial.complexity: Time: O(N²) (or O(N log N) with sorting)  |  Space: O(N)
